name: com.cognivators/mcp-safeguard
description: MCP server security scanner: detects prompt injection, credential leaks, SSRF, tool poisoning.

tools.name: scan_config
tools.description: Scan an MCP server configuration file for security vulnerabilities. Detects prompt injection (PI-001–PI-019), credential leaks (CRED-001–025), SSRF risks (SS-001–003), and tool poisoning (TP-001–008). Returns CVSS-scored findings with remediation guidance.

config_path.description: Path to the Claude Desktop or MCP config JSON file to scan

tools.name: scan_tools
tools.description: Scan raw MCP tool definitions for security vulnerabilities without a config file. Accepts a list of tool objects and returns findings.
Array of MCP tool definition objects with name, description, and inputSchema
